notes: Read all 28 numbered source lines before editing. The source is pure, non-visual widget-catalogue metadata (no JSX, state, API path, unit handling, or i18n) — the 'media' slice of WIDGET_REGISTRY — so every data field of every entry is ported verbatim and only the two browser-only fields are made native-safe, following the established battery.ts registry sibling idiom (WidgetPicker / DashboardSettingsModal inline native-safe mirrors of these same types).

L1 `import { lazy } from 'react'` -> dropped: the native-safe port stores each widget's component as its module-path string (componentModule) instead of a live React.lazy import, so no react import is needed and no missing/browser module is import()-ed (which would break the native build). The lazy-load intent is preserved as data + documented in the file header.

L2 `import { Music, ListMusic } from 'lucide-react'` -> dropped (lucide-react is browser-only and must not enter native output). Each per-entry `icon: <LucideComponent>` becomes `iconName: '<LucideIdentifier>'` preserving exactly which icon each widget uses (Music, ListMusic); the rendered glyph is intentionally not synthesised here (a consumer maps name->glyph, per the WidgetPicker CATEGORY_ICON idiom).

L3 `import type { WidgetDef } from '../types'` -> the web ../types module imports lucide-react LucideIcon + React.lazy types, so the slice WidgetDef needs (WidgetSize, WidgetCategory, WidgetHelp, WidgetDef) is mirrored inline native-safe; WidgetDef's `icon: LucideIcon` -> `iconName: string` and `component: LazyExoticComponent<...>` -> `componentModule: string`, all other fields identical. Types are kept module-local (not exported) so the native export surface mirrors the web file's (only MEDIA_WIDGETS).
L4 blank line preserved. L5 `export const MEDIA_WIDGETS: WidgetDef[] = [` -> preserved verbatim as the sole export. L28 closing `];` preserved. L29 trailing blank line preserved.
